Update a household wiki with an LLM via MCP
The author's wife plugged an MCP server into their household Wiki.js so an LLM can update the wiki.
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
The author's wife connected an MCP server to their household Wiki.js. With that in place, an LLM can update the wiki's pages. The post gives no detail on which server, model or prompts were used, or on what the LLM actually edits. It also doesn't say where a person steps in.
How it went
The author found it surprising that an LLM can update the wiki at all. The post states no results, numbers or shortcomings.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
Help me connect an MCP server to my [wiki software, e.g. Wiki.js] at [URL] so an AI assistant can read and update our household pages. Walk me through setup and the access token with the narrowest permissions needed. Then test it by drafting an update to the page [page name], and show me the proposed edit before saving anything.
Original source: https://bsky.app/profile/avengingfem.me/post/3m2xnm7hea22f
